purpose: Validate the user-proposed seven-variable CAD domain against the V6 parameterization adapter. Values are tested in isolated copies only; no Flow project or solver is run.

alpha_deg.meaning: 全锥角；对应物理半锥角 10°～20°

notes: alpha_deg is the full cone angle in the external design JSON. The CAD adapter writes alpha_deg/2 into the four half-angle sketches.
A CAD pass means the isolated V6 copy reports completed=true and physical_mapping_verified=true after rebuild, save, reopen, geometric readback, and assembly feature checks.
Flow lids, Flow project creation, meshing, and solver execution are intentionally excluded from this range-validation pass.
